parameter.name: name
parameter.description: The Solace connection name to use.

parameter.name: destinationType
parameter.description: Destination type: TOPIC or QUEUE (default: TOPIC).

parameter.name: destinationName
parameter.description: Name of the topic or queue to send the request to.

parameter.name: deliveryMode
parameter.description: Delivery mode: DIRECT, PERSISTENT, or NON_PERSISTENT (default: DIRECT). PERSISTENT/NON_PERSISTENT use a temporary queue for guaranteed request-reply.

parameter.name: messageType
parameter.description: Message type: TEXT, BYTES, or XML (default: TEXT). The body is written by the platform formatter of its content type, and this value selects the Solace message class. JSON has no message class of its own. Send it as TEXT or BYTES.

parameter.name: requestTimeout
parameter.description: Maximum time to wait for response in milliseconds (default: 30000).

parameter.name: correlationId
parameter.description: Correlation ID for the request message.

parameter.name: priority
parameter.description: Message priority (0-255).

parameter.name: timeToLive
parameter.description: Time to live in milliseconds.

parameter.name: applicationMessageId
parameter.description: Application-defined message ID.

parameter.name: applicationMessageType
parameter.description: Application-defined message type.

parameter.name: senderId
parameter.description: Sender ID for the request message.

parameter.name: userProperties
parameter.description: Custom user properties as a JSON array of objects, for example [{"region":"US"},{"priority":"high"}]. A string stays a string, an integer becomes a long, a decimal a double and a boolean a boolean. A receiver reads each one as the attribute userProp_ followed by the key.

parameter.name: dmqEligible
parameter.description: Whether the message is eligible for the Dead Message Queue (true/false).

parameter.name: elidingEligible
parameter.description: Whether the message is eligible for eliding (true/false).

parameter.name: expiration
parameter.description: Absolute message expiration time as a UTC epoch in milliseconds (0 means no expiration).

parameter.name: waitForAck
parameter.description: Whether to wait for the broker acknowledgement of a PERSISTENT or NON_PERSISTENT request before waiting for the reply. Default: true for PERSISTENT and NON_PERSISTENT. Ignored for DIRECT.

parameter.name: ackTimeout
parameter.description: Deadline in milliseconds for the send and the broker acknowledgement of the request. Default: 10000. The requestTimeout bounds the whole operation.

parameter.name: contentType
parameter.description: The content type the reply is read with, for example application/json. It applies to the reply only, the request keeps the content type of the message context. It wins over the type the reply declares. Empty uses the declared type, else the default of its message class. The payload is never inspected. A value without a charset takes the charset the reply declares, else UTF-8.

parameter.name: responseVariable
parameter.description: The name of the variable to which the output should be stored.

parameter.name: overwriteBody
parameter.description: Replace the Message Body in Message Context with the response.
